findings.description: Hard-coded setwd() in E1, E2 (author's G: drive path), E3 commented out; driver sets the working directory to the data folder.
E1 calls install.packages('PairedData') mid-script; commented out (package provided by the environment).
findings.suggested_fix: Move installs to a setup script.

findings.description: Resolved by normalization. E1 halts as shipped under current data.table (1.18.6.1): melt(measure.vars = list(belief = ...)) now names the value column 'belief' and codes variable 1..18, so labels are never assigned and cor.test() errors ('x' and 'y' must have the same length). Restored the pre-1.15 output with a 4-line post-melt edit; no computation line changed.
findings.suggested_fix: Pin data.table (renv.lock) or use measure.vars = c(...) with value.name = 'value'.

findings.description: E1 calls melt() on a plain data.frame, which data.table < 1.15 redirected to reshape2; current data.table errors. A melt.data.frame shim calling reshape2's method was added in the driver (script unchanged).
findings.suggested_fix: library(reshape2) explicitly or use data.table::melt on a data.table.

findings.description: E1 sample size reporting: paper says 133 recruited and 17 excluded, but the shipped data have 150 rows and 133 participants are analysed (df = 132 in the reported t-tests agrees with the code). The abstract N = 886 equals 133 + 458 + 295, i.e. E1 and E2 analysed counts plus E3 recruited count.
E2 sample size reporting: paper says 458 recruited and 108 excluded (33 + 72 = 105); shipped data have 563 rows, the script excludes 105 and analyses 458.
E2 participant-level heterogeneity: paper says UPCO and Competence best predict 'one quarter' of participants; shipped code gives 30.8% (correlation) and 38.2% (deviation).

E3 proportion-heuristic AIC: shipped lmer gives 1766.3 vs reported ~1722. The formula post_j ~ (t / (t + f)) is parsed by R as nesting (t + t:(t+f)), not as a proportion; refitting with I(t / (t + f)) gives AIC 1721.98, matching the reported ~1722. Judgement: analysis-code difference (the shipped formula is not the one that produced the reported value), not version drift.
findings.suggested_fix: Use I(t / (t + f)) in the shipped script.

findings.description: E3 single-model AICs in the text (~410/497/507) come from a mixed model that the shipped script only describes in a comment; the code as shipped prints fixed-effects AICs (463/570/785). Recomputed with lmer following the comment, they match.
findings.suggested_fix: Ship the mixed-model code that produced the reported values.

findings.description: E1 per-participant best-model shares (~75% / ~80%) have no code in E1_analysis.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the participant-level classification code for E1.

findings.description: E2 participant-level plot labels: which.min/which.max index follows column order (Competence, UPCO, Bayes) but percplotd labels them (UPCO, Competence, Bayes), swapping UPCO and Competence in Fig. 6b. The Bayes share is unaffected.
Correlation-difference tests are reported as t but psych::paired.r returns z.
Manual exclusions by hard-coded row indices after reading free-text responses (E1 comp_exclude, E2 good_exp). They reproduce, but cannot be derived from the stated criteria alone.
findings.suggested_fix: Ship the coding of free-text responses.

findings.description: No package versions, sessionInfo or lockfile shipped; E3 prior-fit plot uses unseeded rnorm() jitter.

limitations: Pilot run: the bundle is not published; github_url points to the ReproCrowd project repository, not to a repository for this certificate.
No nanopublications were minted and no Zenodo DOI exists (see nanopubs/PUBLISHED.md).

Certified numbers were produced with host R 4.6.1 and current CRAN binaries; pixi.lock pins conda-forge r-base 4.5.3 and was solved and installed, and the Snakemake DAG was dry-run, but the full pipeline was not re-executed under pixi.
Pilot studies (pilot1-3, E3pilot scripts) and Supplemental Material values were not checked.
Reported values were transcribed from the author-hosted PDF of the published version (cognition.princeton.edu); quotes were checked against pdftotext output, not with a verify_quote tool.
The prompt's rule-pack and schema URLs (lukasroeseler.github.io) returned 404; the forrtproject.github.io copies were used.
